mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_details ( order_id, product_id, quantity, price, subtotal ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, #{price}, #{subtotal} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id AS orderId, product_id AS productId, quantity, price, subtotal AS subTotal, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM order_details WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY id
